author: TeIq
content: Origin: #27 audit. The published app.bsky.labeler.service record alone does NOT make Polaris discoverable — the operator's DID document needs its #atproto_labeler service entry pointing at the same service_url. polaris-publish-labeler-record validates the URL early but stops short of updating the DID document. Helper CLI or doc snippet needed. Likely shape: `polaris-publish-did-service` companion that calls com.atproto.identity.updateHandle / signPlcOperation depending on did:method.
